com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Interface QuoteRequest

  • All Superinterfaces:
    TurnAroundAware
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    BundleQuoteRequest, DefaultQuoteRequest

    public interface QuoteRequest
extends TurnAroundAware
    Purpose of this interface is to provide possible request options while making a request or subscription for Quote or Quote chain. Using Filters is very important for Chain requests since overall response can be reduced to a certain degree. The same QuoteRequest can be used for "request", "subscribeChain" etc. In general, QuoteRequest makes it possible for clients to requests only the data that the user is really interested in.
    Since:
    01-001-0014
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

      • addFilter

        QuoteRequest addFilter(QuoteRequestFilter<?> quoteRequestFilter)
        Before adding a filter make sure that the filter can even be applied to this type of QuoteRequest. It can be determined by looking at the CHAIN_TYPE and calling isApplicableTo() method of QuoteRequestFilter. The filters are specific to implementation, thus apply only the filters for the implementation that you are using.
        Parameters:
        quoteRequestFilter - Filter to be added on
        Returns:
        This request object itself
